nodes.description: Library function checking via extcodesize whether an address is a contract; used to validate new proxy implementations.
Payable fallback of the proxy; forwards all unmatched calls to _fallback().
Payable receive function; forwards plain value transfers to _fallback().
Virtual internal function returning the implementation address; overridden by UpgradeabilityProxy.
Internal function performing an assembly delegatecall to an arbitrary implementation address, then returning/reverting based on result.
Virtual hook executed at the beginning of the fallback path.
Core fallback routine: calls _willFallback() then _delegate(_implementation()).
Constructor setting the initial implementation slot and optionally delegatecalling initialization data into the logic contract.
Reads the EIP-1967 implementation slot via assembly sload and returns the stored address.
Internal upgrade routine storing a new implementation and emitting Upgraded.
Validates the new implementation is a contract and writes it into the implementation storage slot via assembly sstore.
Constructor initializing the admin slot in addition to the inherited implementation setup.
External admin-gated getter returning the current proxy admin address.
External admin-gated getter returning the current implementation address.
Admin-gated function transferring proxy administration to a new address after a zero-address check.
Admin-gated function upgrading the backing implementation address.
Admin-gated function upgrading the implementation and delegatecalling arbitrary initialization data into the new implementation.
Internal assembly sload of the EIP-1967 admin storage slot.
Internal assembly sstore writing the admin address into the admin storage slot.
Overridden fallback hook that forbids the proxy admin from using the fallback path.
Immutable constant EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address.
Immutable constant EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
Caller-controlled address used by the ifAdmin authorization checks and the fallback guard.
Low-level assembly delegatecall transferring full control (storage and funds) to the implementation address; reentrancy-prone.

Delegatecall of caller-supplied data into the newly set implementation, executed after the storage slot was already overwritten.
Raw assembly sstore writing the implementation address into a fixed storage slot.
Raw assembly sstore writing the admin address into a fixed storage slot.

edges.reason: fallback() forwards execution to _fallback().
receive() forwards execution to _fallback().
_fallback() invokes the _willFallback() hook first.
_fallback() resolves the implementation address via _implementation().
_fallback() delegates the call through _delegate().
_delegate() performs the assembly delegatecall, giving the callee full control and reentrancy potential.
The implementation address parameter flows directly into the delegatecall target.
_implementation() sloads the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant.
_setImplementation() uses IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT as the sstore destination.
_setImplementation() executes the raw sstore writing the implementation.
_setImplementation() calls Address.isContract to validate the new implementation.
The account parameter is consumed by isContract's extcodesize check.
isContract assigns the extcodesize result to the local size variable.
_upgradeTo() calls _setImplementation() before emitting Upgraded.
The newImplementation parameter is used by _upgradeTo().
The constructor calls _setImplementation(_logic) to initialize the slot.
The constructor delegatecalls initialization data into the logic contract when _data is non-empty.
The _logic parameter flows into the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
The _data parameter flows into the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
Unvalidated _data is used as the delegatecall payload in the constructor.
The success flag local is defined by the constructor's delegatecall result.
The AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor invokes the parent UpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
The constructor calls _setAdmin(_admin) to store the admin.
The _logic parameter flows into the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
The _admin parameter flows into the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
The _data parameter flows into the AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor.
admin() is guarded by ifAdmin which compares msg.sender to the stored admin.
implementation() is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
changeAdmin() is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
upgradeTo() is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
upgradeToAndCall() is guarded by the ifAdmin msg.sender check.
_willFallback() requires msg.sender not to be the proxy admin.
_willFallback() reads the admin via _admin() for the restriction check.
_willFallback() calls super._willFallback() after the admin check.
admin() returns the value produced by _admin().
implementation() returns the value produced by _implementation().
changeAdmin() reads the current admin via _admin() for the AdminChanged event.
changeAdmin() calls _setAdmin(newAdmin).
The newAdmin parameter is consumed by changeAdmin().
upgradeTo() calls the internal _upgradeTo().
The newImplementation parameter is consumed by upgradeTo().
upgradeToAndCall() first calls _upgradeTo(newImplementation).
upgradeToAndCall() delegatecalls arbitrary data into the new implementation after the upgrade.
The newImplementation parameter is consumed by upgradeToAndCall().
The data parameter is consumed by upgradeToAndCall().
Caller-supplied data is used directly as the delegatecall payload.
Caller-supplied implementation address is the delegatecall target.
The success local is defined by the delegatecall result inside upgradeToAndCall().
_admin() sloads the ADMIN_SLOT constant.
_setAdmin() uses ADMIN_SLOT as the sstore destination.
_setAdmin() executes the raw sstore writing the admin.
The newAdmin parameter is written into the admin slot by _setAdmin().
The newAdmin parameter flows into the raw sstore operation.
The adm return variable receives the sload result inside _admin().
The local slot variable supplies the storage key inside _admin().
The local slot variable supplies the storage key for the sstore in _setAdmin().
The newImplementation parameter is consumed by _setImplementation().
UpgradeabilityProxy._implementation overrides Proxy._implementation.
The overridden _willFallback hook calls back into the base hook during fallback execution.
